title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1980-05-15
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 >> Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5 -6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96] >> 16/44.1
source: 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5M >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Decent audience tape of a solid 1980 show with high‑energy Jack Straw, Franklin's Tower and Lazy Lightning>Supplication, though Althea falls flat.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture that, while not pristine, offers clear enough sound to enjoy the performance. The concert shines on several mid‑set numbers—Jack Straw, Peggy-O, Lost Sailor → Saint, Franklin's Tower, Lazy Lightning → Supplication and Stranger—while the second‑set opener Althea is notably weak. Overall reviewers rate both show and tape positively.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews consistently give 4–5 stars, praising many songs and the tape’s listenability despite modest recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Aud (AUD) tape is solid for the era—clear enough with some ambient room feel; Brent's toy‑piano/organ noises are audible but not distracting.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong energy after a weak Althea opener; the rest of the set builds momentum with high‑octane numbers and tight playing, especially from Jerry.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tighter and more focused in 1980 than earlier years; wakes up after Althea.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent still uses toy‑piano/organ sounds but plays well to the room.
